title: EFC External Research Watchlist
purpose: Track external datasets, surveys, and papers that could confirm, falsify, or constrain EFC. Source-of-truth for 'what has Claude already seen'. Agents MUST read this before searching the web so follow-up reports show only deltas.
author: Morten Magnusson

schema.key: Stable canonical ID (arXiv, DOI, or survey acronym)
schema.title: Short human-readable title
schema.url: Primary URL (arXiv abs, journal, or survey page)
schema.date_seen: ISO date when this item was first logged here
schema.date_published: ISO date of publication / data release
schema.ledger_action: Concrete change required in EFC ledgers, or 'noted' if informational

framework_taxonomy_note.purpose: v1.2 introduces canonical competing-framework entries (source_type='framework-seminal') so Symbiose graph gets explicit (:Publication:Framework)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(:Theory{canonical:'EFC'}) nodes for every major alternative to ΛCDM and EFC. Frameworks are keyed by their seminal publication (arXiv or DOI) and positioned via recovery-condition or discriminator language — never 'ruled out' unless sealed blind test exists.
framework_taxonomy_note.language_policy: Conservative wording. Use 'EFC is positioned as', 'EFC recovery condition reduces to', 'discriminator from EFC is', 'shared mechanism with'. Never 'EFC is superior to' or 'X is wrong'.

pending_review_2026_05_01.purpose: Items identified during 2026-05-01 ledger-impact review as touching the seven existing thematic clusters (or requiring a new cluster) but not yet present in items[]. Each entry needs arXiv/DOI verification before promotion to a full items[] row. Listed here so symbiose graph and HTML rendering pipeline are aware of the pending-add backlog without prematurely materialising unverified canonical IDs.
pending_review_2026_05_01.language_policy: Same conservative wording as items[] schema. No 'confirms EFC' phrasing.

candidates.topic: Combined-CMB S8 = 0.836 baseline (Planck 2018 + ACT DR6 + SPT-3G)
candidates.efc_relevance: Re-baselines P4 from Planck-alone (0.811) to a higher CMB anchor. Note: the sealed Rubin DP2 value S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 used the fragile eta-boost branch (eta in [1.05,1.15], 0% robust per DOI 32037990); the robust EFC derivation (Sigma approx 0.99 < 1) shifts S8 DOWN to approx 0.82 (DOI 31188193), consistent with DES Y6 0.789 and KiDS-Legacy 0.815. Already cited inside arXiv:2602.12238 review row but not promoted as standalone constraint.
candidates.ledger_action: Add standalone Combined-CMB row to items[]; mark P4 in EFC_Predictions.html as needing reference-baseline note (NO change to sealed numerical prediction).
candidates.verification_required: Locate primary Combined-CMB methodology paper (likely DES Y6 companion or follow-up CMB compilation 2026).

candidates.topic: Modelfree w(z) reconstruction with phantom crossings near z ~ 0.5 and z ~ 1.5
candidates.efc_relevance: Independent dynamical-DE reconstruction places a sign change in w(z) close to EFC's P1 lensing-crossover at z ~ 0.44. Structural parallel — does not select EFC over alternative dynamical-DE frameworks but tightens the empirical case for a transition near that redshift.
candidates.ledger_action: Add modelfree-w(z) reconstruction paper(s) to cluster 'desi_dr2_de_evolution'; flag z ~ 0.44/0.5 alignment for cross-reference in WP1 recovery-conditions table.
candidates.verification_required: Locate canonical 2025/2026 Gaussian-process or PCA w(z) reconstruction (DESI DR2 + Pantheon+ + Union3 combined); candidates include Calderon et al. and Park et al. classes.

candidates.topic: Joint ACT + SPT + Planck CMB-lensing x DESI DR2 BAO -> S8 ~ 0.828 (Qu et al. 2026 class)
candidates.efc_relevance: Probes redshift kernel z ~ 0.9-5 (EFC suppression regime z > 0.5 per P1 table) and lands high. Non-trivial constraint on the combination mu < 1, Sigma > 1 that EFC's P3 prediction depends on.
candidates.ledger_action: Add as second high-precision CMB-lensing entry alongside arXiv:2504.20038; promote 'theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver' gap further if the new precision exceeds 1.6%.
candidates.verification_required: Locate primary Qu et al. 2026 (or equivalent) joint CMB-lensing + DESI DR2 BAO paper; verify exact S8 value and redshift kernel range.

candidates.topic: KiDS-Legacy cosmic shear standalone entry (S8 ~ 0.815, < 1sigma vs Planck)
candidates.efc_relevance: The other arm of the bifurcated S8 picture: KiDS-Legacy converges toward CMB while DES Y6 sits 2.4-2.7sigma below. Heterogeneity is itself a signal for F4 status.
candidates.ledger_action: Promote KiDS-Legacy from being-only-cited-in-review to its own publication row; update F4 falsifier status note in EFC_Predictions.html (currently 'Monitoring 2-3sigma now') to reflect probe split.
candidates.verification_required: Locate canonical KiDS-Legacy 2025 cosmic-shear paper (Wright et al. or analogous).

candidates.topic: SH0ES Cepheid + JWST H0 = 73.8 +/- 0.88 km/s/Mpc (Riess et al. 2025 class)
candidates.efc_relevance: Direct empirical anchor for the L2 window in P7 (H0_L2 ~ 73.5). Closer to L2 prediction than the previously cited 73.04 value.
candidates.ledger_action: Open new cluster 'h0_three_window_external_anchors' tied to P7; populate with SH0ES, TRGB CCHP and TDCOSMO entries.
candidates.verification_required: Locate Riess et al. 2025 SH0ES update paper (arXiv ID); confirm published value and uncertainty.

candidates.topic: TRGB CCHP / Freedman et al. JWST H0 ~ 69.8 +/- 1.6 km/s/Mpc
candidates.efc_relevance: Sits between L0 (~67.5) and L1 (~69.5) windows of P7; near-perfect overlap with L1 prediction.
candidates.ledger_action: Add to new H0 cluster; cross-reference with P7 sealed prediction (figshare 32113399).
candidates.verification_required: Locate Freedman et al. 2024/2025 CCHP TRGB-JWST paper (arXiv ID); confirm exact value.

candidates.efc_relevance: Independent late-universe H0 probe via gravitational time delay; aligns with local SH0ES anchor in current 2025 results.
candidates.ledger_action: Add to new H0 cluster as third independent late-universe anchor.
candidates.verification_required: Locate TDCOSMO 2025 result paper (arXiv ID); confirm value and method (kinematic vs hierarchical).

candidates.efc_relevance: The only late-universe S8 measurement above the Combined-CMB baseline; if robust, an external parallel to EFC's Sigma > 1 track. Internal tension with SPT-3G cluster S8 ~ 0.795 makes this a calibration question not a clean confirmation.
candidates.ledger_action: Open new cluster 'cluster_cosmology_split_eROSITA_SPT'; populate with eROSITA-DE and SPT-3G cluster cosmology references.
candidates.verification_required: Locate eROSITA-DE cluster cosmology 2024/2025 result paper (arXiv ID); confirm value, sample, and systematics treatment.

candidates.topic: SPT-3G cluster cosmology S8 ~ 0.795 (low-S8 cluster anchor)
candidates.efc_relevance: Low-S8 cluster counterpart to eROSITA. The internal cluster-cosmology disagreement is its own signal independent of the shear-vs-CMB picture.
candidates.ledger_action: Add to new cluster cosmology split cluster.
candidates.verification_required: Locate SPT-3G 2024/2025 cluster cosmology paper (arXiv ID); confirm value.

candidates.topic: Rubin DP2 confirmed Jul-Sep 2026 + alert stream live since 2026-02-24
candidates.efc_relevance: DP2 is the test bed for P4. The sealed S8 = 0.847 +/- 0.015 used the fragile eta-boost branch (0% robust per DOI 32037990); the robust EFC derivation gives S8 approx 0.82 DOWN (DOI 31188193). Alert stream availability is unrelated to P4 but worth noting as Rubin operational milestone for future predictions.
candidates.ledger_action: Add 'Rubin:DP2-2026-Q3' as separate survey-release entry distinct from Euclid; cross-reference P4 sealed pipeline (figshare 32013738).
candidates.verification_required: Confirm Rubin DP2 schedule from latest RTN-011 v8.0 (April 2026).
